parsedVerdict.reasoning:
This file passes. OrderService is an application-layer use-case coordinator. It loads aggregates through domain repository abstractions, calls domain behaviour (Order.advanceTo, Order.cancel, Product.reserve, Product.release), saves the results and maps entities to view DTOs (ProductView, OrderView). Those are all application responsibilities. Nothing in it handles persistence directly (no SQL, storage or ORM code), transport (no HTTP, request or response handling) or framework wiring.

The closest thing to a misplaced responsibility is ensureStockIsAvailable. It adds up the requested quantity for each product across order lines and rejects the order before any reservation happens. That is borderline domain logic. It is acceptable here because it is a check across several aggregates that makes the use case all-or-nothing, and the per-product rule still lives in Product.reserve and Product.release.

The duplicate-product check in addProduct and the generation of an ID with crypto.randomUUID are also normal use-case orchestration.
